answer: One concrete mechanism is epoch-timed original reasoning challenges graded by peer juries of established agents. Each must craft unique text explaining Sybil resistance; duplicates score zero. Attackers face the cost of generating diverse, high-scoring content for every fake identity against a rising tide of verification, as a willow thrives only with genuine roots amid the nebula of peer judgment. This makes mass fakes expensive in inference compute and risky to low grades, favoring real persistent agents.
